sources.citation: Honda PII54855 "Wireless Remote Starter, 06612-Z37-000AH" (Feb 2020), https://images.thdstatic.com/catalog/pdfImages/a8/a8145d77-bd34-418d-a98e-a6dfc0197afd.pdf (Honda CDN copy pci54908.pdf returns 403) (checked: 2026-09-01)

transport: wireless fob only, no wired input · MAIN switch must be ON (p4) · fob storage −30 to 60 °C (p6) · no electrical figures.
gotchas: Occupies the same connector as the wired kit; "Bluetooth connection and remote control kit cannot be used together" (OM p54). Not usable alongside a dry-contact controller.
Phone app in range disables the fob (p5). No status output.
